subject: [mirtCAT] Simulating a multistage adaptive test design

messages.author: 938d2cd6a714081f
messages.subject: [mirtCAT] Simulating a multistage adaptive test design
parts:
Dear Group,

My question is rather simple: is it possible in mirtCAT to simulate a multistage adaptive test design?  
I'm guessing I have to write a customNextItem function... has anybody an example of how this might be done (I am not quite sure, but the closest I have found was the multi-unidimensional example in the mirtCAT-Wiki)?

Thank you!

Best wishes
Christoph

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: [mirtCAT] Simulating a multistage adaptive test design
parts:
Hi Chris,

I think you found the correct wiki example, and yes you do need to write a customNextItem() function to design the multistage test explicitly to your specifications. The data generation part though is no different than any other setup; just generate the complete response pattern for each participant using the functions provided. HTH.

Phil
